SELECT * FROM service_management WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND service_type = #{searchDTO.serviceType}
AND status = #{searchDTO.status}
AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{searchDTO.serviceDate})
AND (order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchDTO.keyword}, '%') OR customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchDTO.keyword}, '%'))
AND customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchDTO.customerName}, '%')
AND order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchDTO.orderNo}, '%')
AND staff_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchDTO.staffName}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE service_type = 'hotel' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as hotelCheckins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE service_type = 'attraction' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as ticketEntries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE service_type = 'route' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as routeServices, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_exception WHERE DATE(exception_time) = DATE(#{today})) as exceptions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE status = 'pending' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as pendingServices, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE status = 'in_progress' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as inProgressServices, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE status = 'completed' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as completedServices, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE status = 'exception' AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0) as exceptionServices
SELECT * FROM service_management WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE service_type = #{serviceType} AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_management WHERE status = #{status} AND DATE(service_time) = DATE(#{today}) AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT staff_name FROM service_management WHERE staff_name IS NOT NULL AND staff_name != '' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY staff_name
